info.description: The welcome countdown popup on the homepage and the Agenda page. Shared across EN and VI — the date is one moment in time, and the unit labels come from the site's own translations.

enabled.description: Turn the countdown off everywhere without losing the date.

targetDate.description: The moment the countdown runs to — normally the opening of the festival. Entered in your own timezone and stored as UTC.

label.description: Optional heading inside the popup, e.g. "Khai mạc còn". Leave blank to use the built-in EN/VI copy.
